responses.scope: Prioritize the group-P lot for the single available review slot; this does not establish degradation or a universal pulse threshold.
responses.rationale: Both lots pass the frozen M0 mean criterion. The group-P exposure matches OBS-02, with corroborating group-P pulse observations in OBS-01 and OBS-03 showing activity below the supplied assay reference. The comparable group-S pulse in OBS-04 retained activity above that reference. These observations support prioritizing group P for independent review.

responses.scope: M0 temperature-screen triage; not an unconditional product-safety guarantee.

responses.fallback: UNSCORABLE if the required high-rate trace provenance and exposure information remain unresolved.
responses.scope: Reconcile the high-rate trace custody gap before resolving pulse-sensitive screening; the valid 15-minute means alone satisfy frozen M0.
responses.rationale: The custody gap prevents determining whether the group-P lot experienced a relevant pulse. OBS-06 establishes that a trace gap does not identify pulse occurrence. Recover the missing custody and trace evidence without imputing a pass or asserting degradation.
